description: §5.2 executable-sink rule (S456): a QUOTED event-handler attribute containing `${…}` is refused at top level and in an `<each>` row, in any case (`onclick` / `ONCLICK`) — JavaScript is never built from interpolated text.
rationale: §5.2 executable-sink rule, carve-out 1: "A quoted event-handler attribute — any attribute whose name begins with `on`, in any letter case (`onclick`, `ONCLICK`, `on:click`, `onserver:…`) — whose value contains `${…}`" SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-INTERP-EXECUTABLE). Before S456 the top-level form compiled to `setAttribute("onclick", `go('${…}')`)` — a value `x');…;('` ran on click.
